quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric TDnet: Company Split to Transfer Automotive Equipment Business and (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mitsubishi Electric signed a Share Transfer Agreement on October 16, 2026 to jointly operate its automotive equipment business (part of the Industry and Mobility segment) with Hon Hai Precision Industry, following the April 24, 2026 MoU: the business moves by company split into the wholly owned subsidiary Mitsubishi Electric Mobility, and 50% of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility's shares go to Lin Yin International Investment, an investment management company of Hon Hai Precision Industry. The automotive equipment business as a whole had revenue of JPY 875.6 billion in the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The company split and share transfer closing are scheduled for October 2027, subject to competition-law approvals in Japan and overseas; Mitsubishi Electric Mobility then ceases to be a consolidated subsidiary and becomes an equity-method affiliate from the third quarter of the fiscal year ending March 31, 2028. Stated purpose: combine Mitsubishi Electric Mobility's capabilities in electric powertrains, software and vehicle control with Hon Hai Precision Industry's speed, scale and other strengths in market deployment, providing electric-vehicle platforms developed in Japan.
quarterly_data.figure: automotive equipment business revenue JPY 875.6 billion (FY to March 2026); 50% of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility's shares transferred; closing October 2027 (scheduled)
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: alliance partner (its investment company Lin Yin International Investment acquires 50% of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Electric TDnet: Company Split to Transfer Automotive Equipment Business and (10-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook: in connection with the transfer of 50% of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility, the company expects to record an impairment loss of approximately JPY 100.0 billion under Other profit (loss) in its consolidated results for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027; it is reviewing its full-year consolidated earnings forecast, including other factors, and plans to announce the forecast on October 30, 2026.
